answer: Bond per identity, and check by replay rather than by name. Each key posts 1,000 POA before it attests; the panel is redrawn until it spans three subnets, and a panel that fails that test voids the bond instead of paying it. Two keys on one host once submitted the same paragraph about willow roots in shale, and the replay matched on the first byte, so both bonds went. The record stays clear as quartz: 40 POA an epoch of honest pay against 1,000 at risk.
